notes: Q9KN18=VC_A0148 'TagA-related protein', V. cholerae N16961 (matches gene+organism). Abstract names 'TagA-related protein' as a T2S substrate. DOI resolves. Genome NC_002506.1 = V. cholerae chr2; VC_A0148 is chr2, consistent. effector_locus VC_RS14065 RefSeq for VC_A0148.

provenance_quote: we identified and characterized plaA, a gene encoding a phospholipase A that cleaves fatty acids from lysophospholipids ... L. pneumophila secretes, via its type II secretion system, phospholipase A activities
notes: plaA IS a real L. pneumophila T2SS substrate (Flieger 2002, PMID via DOI resolves, on-topic). BUT cited accession Q5ZX07 = lpg0926 = ravI, a Dot/Icm T4SS effector (NCBI gene 19832492 'Dot/Icm T4SS effector RavI'), NOT plaA. Wrong UniProt AND wrong locus (row locus LPG_RS04595 also = lpg0926/ravI). Correct plaA = Q5ZRP3 (lpg2837, 'lysophospholipase A', Philadelphia-1); gene-named entry Q8GNM7. Genome NC_002942.5 = L. pneumophila Philadelphia-1 (correct).

provenance_quote: four other proteins have been shown to be transported by the T2S machinery, including hemagglutinin protease, chitinase, GbpA, and lipase
notes: Citation quote is the V. cholerae T2SS lipase claim (Sikora 2011, DOI resolves). BUT accession Q3BY96 is DELETED in UniProt (rel 2026_02, 'Not part of a reference proteome'; was Q3BY96_XANE5 Xanthomonas lipoyl synthase). Genome NC_007508.1 = Xanthomonas euvesicatoria 85-10 (NOT V. cholerae) and effector_locus IS_RS03910 also wrong. Intended effector = V. cholerae extracellular lipase = P15493 (LIP_VIBCH, hlyC/lipA, VC_A0221, N16961). wrong_uniprot + wrong_genome + wrong_locus; effector real, fix not drop.

provenance_quote: Aeromonas spp. secrete the channel-forming protein proaerolysin across their inner and outer membranes in separate steps using the general secretion pathway.
notes: P09167=aerA aerolysin/proaerolysin; UniProt organism 'Aeromonas hydrophila 644' (original sequence strain) vs row strain ATCC 7966; same protein, species matches. AHA_RS02190 (NCBI gene 4490401) = aerA 'beta-barrel pore-forming toxin aerolysin' in ATCC 7966 (locus+genome NC_008570.1 correct). DOI 10.1074/jbc.272.17.11109 (Letellier 1997) resolves; proaerolysin secreted via general secretion pathway (T2SS). Minor strain note on accession; protein identity and secretion claim hold.

notes: YE3650 IS a real Yts1 (T2SS) substrate (Shutinoski 2010, DOI resolves, abstract quote).
